Keep everything. Finish the interface, the feedback and check the template. Add this section to game_spec.json and use it for every string:
{"text":{"controlsKeyboard":"WASD/Arrows: move - IJKL: aim and fire","controlsTouch":"Left thumb: move - Right thumb: aim and fire","lose":"Defeated","win":"You survived!","xp":"XP","hp":"HP","kills":"Kills","time":"Time"}}

FLOOR: pre-rendered line-color grid every world.floorGrid units, drawn with the camera offset so movement reads.

HUD (anchored to visible screen edges + safe margin, strings rebuilt only on change)
- Top-left: XP (large), kills below, then an HP bar 240x16 (player color on line track, hazard color under 30%).
- Top-center: timer m:ss (remaining if rules.duration > 0, elapsed otherwise); "Wave N" toast under it for 1.5 s.
- Top-right: pause button.
- While a joystick is held: base ring (line color, radius joystickRadius) at the touch origin and a knob (player color for move, special for aim).

SCREENS
- Title: attract mode with the arena drifting slowly and 10 idle enemies, game title, best score, hints text.controlsKeyboard and text.controlsTouch (highlight the last input type used), text.tapToStart.
- Result: text.lose or text.win, XP score, best with "New best!", time survived, kills, buttons Play again and Menu.

FEEDBACK AND SOUND (style.feedback, audio.sfx)
- Shot: 2-particle muzzle burst + shoot sound.
- Enemy hit: white flash + enemyHit; killed: hazard burst + destroy.
- Gem: collect sound; "+N" popup only for values >= 5.
- Heart: positive burst + heal; magnet: special burst + powerup.
- Player hit: flash, screen shake, knockback + hit sound.
- Wave: toast + wave sound. Result: win or lose sound.

DEBUG OVERLAY (debug.showFps)
FPS, enemies / projectiles / gems active, spawn interval, current weights.

ACCEPTANCE CHECK (fix anything that fails, then report)
1. 8-direction move with WASD, arrows, mouse drag (left half) and touch joystick; diagonals not faster.
2. Camera smooth, never shows outside the world; at 32:9 no enemy spawns inside the view.
3. fireMode auto, directional and both work; aim with IJKL, mouse hold (right half) and right joystick, while moving.
4. Player and enemies slide along walls and obstacles, no tunneling, no stuck player.
5. Magnet radius pulls gems, magnet item pulls all gems, hearts cap at maxHp.
6. Spawn rate, enemy mix and waves follow the curves.
7. Surviving rules.duration shows the win screen; hp 0 shows lose; duration 0 is endless.
8. Score shown = XP = value sent with sendScore = best saved.
9. Layout correct at 9:32, 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 32:9; full run with keyboard+mouse and with touch only.
10. No value hard-coded outside game_spec.json, no console errors, no network requests.
List the game_spec.json keys you added in this step, if any.
